verdict.rationale: Dover's own marketing makes a direct claim about the core of this story: employees can submit and track referrals. That claim is a single one-line mention with no documentation of how the flow works, what statuses an employee sees, or how a referrer checks where their candidate stands. Missing for 10: documented employee-facing referral submission flow, referral status visibility for the referrer, help-center or docs detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can refer candidates through a real referral flow — submit, track status, and see where my referral stands

citations.quote: We make it simple to submit and track referrals.
